Received null, at verifyFresh (bio-plane/scripts/fleet-bundle.mjs:1494). (2) test/system/bundle.test.mjs: 'test failed', same cause. Cause: both compare against the built *.bundled.mjs (bio-plane/dist/bio-plane.bundled.mjs, agent-worker/dist/agent-worker.bundled.mjs, pdf-worker/dist/pdf-worker.bundled.mjs), gitignored and never committed. The gate log shows only the rows.mjs row built. buildGenerated (.process/tool/lib/checks.mjs:129) counts a row's path as committed when the ref tracks any file under it; the bundles row in process/config.json names whole dirs (bio-plane/dist, ...), whose *.bundle.json manifests are tracked, so node bio-plane/scripts/bundles.mjs never runs and verifyFresh reads null. Locally, after running bundles.mjs, the suite is 186/186; without it, exactly these 2 fail. Fix is the process's: the row naming the .bundled.mjs files (or the tool building a row with any untracked path under it).
